audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted its own prose and the mirror. win[3] said Ornn while whys[3] says 'Even fight'; win[5]/win[6] said Ornn while whys[5]/whys[6] say his Sheen-barrel spike and crit out-scale you.
audit.why: The mirror (gangplank__ornn) rewrote the chart as one group: L1 Ornn, L2 Ornn, L3 Ornn, L4-5 Skill, L6 Skill, First item Gangplank, 2+ items Gangplank. That matches the existing prose on rows 3-6.
audit.corrected: Whole chart proposed as one atomic group in both layers, ratings inverted from the mirror: 6/10, 6/10, 7/10, 5/10, 5/10, 3/10, 2/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why claimed the first-item window as Ornn's spike; the chart and the mirror both give it to Gangplank.
audit.why: Sheen-barrel and crit arrive before Ornn's tank item converts, which the content layer already stated in whys[5].
audit.corrected: phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten to the Gangplank-favoured item stages; Remove Scurvy 22s/14s written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cannon Barrage's true damage was never stated against the one top laner whose passive doubles bonus resistances.
audit.why: Gangplank R carries the trueDamage flag; Ornn's passive grants additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources. Listed in missingInteractions (resistances-invalidated). Remove Scurvy's heal (needs-antiheal) was also unstated.
audit.corrected: True damage written into spikes[3].text; Grievous Wounds timing written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns tracked Powder Kegs as if it had a cooldown; the kit lists it at 0.
audit.why: Powder Keg placement is not the punishable window — Remove Scurvy is, at 22s rank 1.

edits.before: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Identify how Gangplank contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Gangplank has one keg and Parrrley at 625 range; walk him down and take the level.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Gangplank's Powder Kegs is down.
edits.after: Still pre-W, and a lone Powder Keg is his whole level 2 — break it with an auto and he has nothing behind it.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Powder Kegs's cooldown.
edits.after: His Sheen-barrel rhythm and crit arrive first — trade only when a keg is broken and he steps into your Q.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Gangplank carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: he out-ranges your side-lane pattern. Gangplank carry threat 9.5/10 — close the game before the map decides it.

edits.before: You have no shield, no combo and bad mana — but his early is just barrels, so farm safely and don't trade what you can't answer yet.
edits.after: Gangplank's level 1 is one keg and Parrrley (625 range); your base stats and passive resistances win the straight walk-up, so take it.

edits.before: Still pre-W, his max-range barrel chain pokes you for free; soak it, hold E, and wait for level 3.
edits.after: Still pre-W, but one keg is his whole level 2 — auto it early and his poke evaporates; hold E for level 3.

edits.before: Gangplank's stacked barrels, crit, and global R out-scale your single-target presence — his 2+ item window beats your duel.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage deals true damage, so the bonus resistances you stack do nothing against it — his 2+ item window beats your duel.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Remove Scurvy: 22s at rank 1, 14s maxed — it heals, so buy Grievous Wounds before extended trades. - Powder Kegs: no cooldown on placement; break them with an auto. - Call of the Forge God: 140s — kill windows only.

notes: Left the mid/whys[3] claim that Remove Scurvy 'cleanses that stun' untouched — Searing Charge's terrain impact is a knockup, and displacement is not normally removable by cleanse effects, but the kit files carry no cleanse-eligibility data and the run rules forbid asserting it from them. Flagged in questionsForUser instead. spikes[3].when is 'Late' here while other matchups use '2+ items'; not edited.
